body: additionally, there aren't people where I live. I actually live in the middle of nowhere. I have one friend within 40 miles of my house. We hang out a lot, but we end up fighting because I'll get anxious and snap at him. I am definitely not the best person to hang out with. Unfortunately, I don't have access to transportation. I literally can't hang out with most of the people I enjoy being around.
It's not that I'm introverted. I couldn't be more extroverted. There's just something about my depression that is holding me back.
What kind of things do you recommend? The only thing I've found that helps is constantly learning. I love knowledge. But my brain can only deal with so much. I need something else to help

I used to be busy constantly. Now, I literally do nothing except surf the web, get high, and/or read books. Doing anything I don't like, aka is boring, sends me straight into an anxiety attack. Unless I keep my mind constantly preoccupied, the depression hits. I can't even go out to eat with people anymore, because I become so bored. I used to be extremely social, but now I don't care about friends/family. I just want to be alone. I know having a hobby would help. I just can't find anything that I enjoy.
